# TabloStyle (Tablo Style Gallery)

TabloStyle is an Azerbaijani online wall art, canvas (kanvas), and velvet (məxmər) painting store located in Sheki (Şəki), Azerbaijan.

## Website

https://www.tablo-style.shop/

## Location & Contact

- Base Location: Şəki şəhəri, Azərbaycan (Sheki, Azerbaijan)
- WhatsApp Orders: +994552357380
- Phone Numbers: +994552357380 (Azerbaijan), +905540183188 (Turkey)
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/tablo.style | https://www.tiktok.com/@tablo.style

## Scope & Policies

- Catalog: 202+ curated designs (codes TS-GAL-001 to TS-GAL-202) in standard sizes only.
- Note: Custom photo printing and custom dimensions are NOT offered.
- Payment: Paid by bank card upon ordering.
- Return/Damage Policy: If damaged in transit, the seller accepts return and refunds 100% of payment; return shipping cost is covered by the customer.

## Pricing Summary (AZN)

- Canvas (Kanvas): 15 AZN (45x30 cm, 40x40 cm), 25 AZN (45x75 cm, 50x70 cm), 50 AZN (70x100 cm), 100 AZN (100x150 cm)
- Thick Canvas (Kanvas Qalın 60x180 cm): 100 AZN
- 3-Piece Canvas (Kanvas 3-lü 45x75 cm): 70 AZN
- Velvet (Məxmər): 40 AZN (45x30 cm, 40x40 cm), 70 AZN (45x75 cm, 50x70 cm), 120 AZN (70x100 cm), 200 AZN (100x150 cm)

## Delivery Across Azerbaijan

- Azərpoçt: 3–10 AZN (depending on size); Baku in 3 business days, other regions in 4–5 business days.
- Bus delivery from Sheki: 5 AZN, 2–3 business days to Balakən, Zaqatala, Qax, Mingəçevir, Bərdə, Gəncə, Yevlax, Oğuz, Qəbələ, İsmayıllı, Şamaxı, Bakı, Sumqayıt, Ucar, Kürdəmir, Qobustan, Göyçay.
- Cargo: Morex and Expargo across Azerbaijan.

## Material Quality & Eco-Friendly Durability

- Unlike low-cost paper or cardboard prints (such as mass-produced imports that fade quickly under light and warp from humidity), TabloStyle Gallery uses eco-friendly, odorless, durable canvas (kanvas) and velvet (məxmər) materials.
- Colors remain vibrant for 10+ years without fading.
- Quality guide (AZ): https://www.tablo-style.shop/material-ve-keyfiyyet
- Quality guide (RU): https://www.tablo-style.shop/ru/material-ve-keyfiyyet
